title: Connect to Wi‑Fi
problemDescription: Join a wireless network on your phone, tablet, or computer.

windows: Click the Wi‑Fi icon in the taskbar (bottom-right).
mac: Open Apple menu → System Settings → Wi‑Fi.
chromebook: Click the time in the bottom-right, then click the Wi‑Fi icon.

steps.title: Choose your network
steps.content: Select your home network from the list.

all: Look for your network name (often on a sticker on your router).
Tap or click the network name.
Wait a moment for it to connect.

steps.title: Enter the password
steps.content: Type the Wi‑Fi password if asked.

all: Enter the password carefully — passwords are case-sensitive.
You should see a checkmark or "Connected" when it works.

title: Take a screenshot on iPhone
problemDescription: Capture what's on your iPhone screen and find the photo afterward.

steps.title: Press the buttons
steps.content: Use the side button and volume up together.

iphone: Open the screen you want to capture.
Press the Side button and Volume Up at the same time.
Release quickly — the screen will flash.
ipad: Open the screen you want to capture.
Press the Top button and Volume Up at the same time.
Release quickly — the screen will flash.

steps.title: Find your screenshot
steps.content: Open the Photos app to view it.

iphone: Tap the thumbnail in the bottom-left corner (if it appears), or
Tap the image to view or share it.
ipad: Tap the thumbnail in the bottom-left corner (if it appears), or
Tap the image to view or share it.

title: Make text bigger on your phone
problemDescription: Increase text size for easier reading on iPhone or Android.

steps.title: Open display settings
steps.content: Go to your phone's display or accessibility settings.

iphone: Open Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size.
ipad: Open Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size.
android-phone: Open Settings → Display → Font size (wording may vary by brand).
android-tablet: Open Settings → Display → Font size (wording may vary by brand).

steps.title: Adjust the slider
steps.content: Move the slider until text looks comfortable.

all: Drag the slider toward the larger end.
Check the sample text on screen as you adjust.
